text:
Maya Chen: OK team — quick thread to sync on the pricing page experiment for next week. I want a small, QA-driven lab for tier names + a gated calculator variant that ties into webinar signups. Thoughts?
Dylan Rios: love it. scope? experiment goals?
Maya Chen: primary = reduce inbound confusion and increase qualified leads for Dedicated/Private. Secondary = surface benchmark narrative (latency/cost tradeoffs) in the FAQ.
Leo Park: for tier names we should test technical vs outcomes naming. e.g., 'Dedicated Plus' vs 'Predictable Throughput'. shorter labels -> clearer in grid.
Zoe Patel: agree. propose 3 name buckets: utility (Dedicated), outcome (Predictable Throughput), persona (Platform Team). we can map copy to each.
Dylan Rios: gated calculator idea: small JS widget that asks 3 quick Qs (avg tokens/session, concurrent users, SLA target) then shows estimated monthly cost + recommended tier and invite to a webinar for deeper review. CTA = "Request a Dedicated demo" or "Join pricing webinar".
Maya Chen: perfect. Important: routing — gated calc leads should go to SDR queue 'pricing-webinar' with tags (calc_variant, tier_reco). Zoe can you confirm fields for routing?
Zoe Patel: yes. I'll add hidden inputs: variant_id, recommended_tier, est_monthly_usd, user_email. webhook -> max-cs-bot. Also add utm_campaign=pricing_lab.
max-cs-bot: [system] Incoming lead payload schema accepted. Forwarding to #sales-pricing with tag pricing_lab.
Leo Park: FAQ updates: add a microsection 'How do you choose a tier?' with a 3-step checklist and the benchmark blurb comparing per-token cost vs latency (one-liner). Keep it short.
Dylan Rios: can we include a downloadable one-pager (benchmark narrative) as a gated asset in the webinar flow? that helps SDRs.
Maya Chen: yes. asset = 'Redwood Inference Pricing Benchmarks (1-pager)'. Link only after signup. Webinar hook: "See real workload numbers and live Q&A on tailoring costs".
Zoe Patel: A/B copy for calculator CTA: A= "Get my estimate + webinar invite" B= "See pricing for my app". We'll run on 50/50.
Dylan Rios: timeline?
Maya Chen: build by Wed, QA Thur, soft-launch Fri for internal traffic + newsletter seed Mon. 2-week run.
Leo Park: analytics: track conversion_rate, qualified_lead_rate (SDR tags), avg_estimate_value, webinar_rsvps. Also flag any errors from widget in Sentry.
Zoe Patel: I'll add experiment flag in GTM and set up event names: pricing_calc_shown, pricing_calc_submit, pricing_webinar_signup.
Dylan Rios: copy needs micro FAQ language. I'll write drafts tonight and drop in the doc.
Maya Chen: quick checklist for launch: 1) calculator QA (edge cases), 2) inbound routing test (webhook+SDR), 3) 1-pager asset upload & gated link, 4) GTM events & experiment flag, 5) A/B variant deploy, 6) update FAQ snippet.
Leo Park: I'll own #1 and #2. Zoe owns #3 and #4. Dylan owns #5 and #6.
Maya Chen: perfect. Ping here when each step is done. also add a short note for support: "If customers ask why estimates differ from invoice, route to pricing@redwood and tag calc-variance".
Dylan Rios: noted. I'll have copy in draft in ~4h.
Zoe Patel: routing test scheduled 10:30am tomorrow — will post results here.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: thanks all — excited to see if tier-name framing moves the needle.
Leo Park: :rocket:
Dylan Rios: small nit: let's include a fallback CTA for non-gated users: 'See sample estimates' linking to public example calc.
Maya Chen: good call. add that to the grid near the pricing table.
max-cs-bot: [system] Reminder: experiment flag 'pricing_lab_qanames' will auto-disable in 14 days unless extended.
Maya Chen: noted.
